findings.issue: Story subtitle 'The lander's hatch slides open. Wind...' shown kilometres up during the whole descent and during the ascent (the StoryPlayer CanvasLayer inside the hidden HUD layer stayed drawn; the story was triggered at scene start).
findings.fix: GameHud hides/shows its story layer with itself; surface scene triggers expedition_start and NAV's landing brief on Descent.finished.

findings.issue: Moons, ringed gas giant, sun halo and aurora hang 1.5 km from the site: from 900 m they became huge nearby spheres (Umbra), a pale disc (Ferrum) and a fence of aurora around the map (Nivalis, Umbra).
findings.fix: PlanetSky marks sky_far nodes; PlanetDescent keeps them around the camera and restores them at touchdown.

findings.issue: Dark square of sea around the site (site water plane 5 cm above the descent sea, two translucent layers), white speckle over the far ocean, and the site was a square plateau island.
findings.fix: Site water hidden under the single far sea until touchdown; far-sea foam off (new water shader uniform foam_strength); TerrainBuilder.ocean_shore gives a noisy 40-320 m shoreline (zero at the map edge, so the seam stays closed).

findings.issue: Amber pad marker (no depth test) drawn on top of the lander's hull for most of the approach; it reappeared over the globe during the climb to orbit.
findings.fix: Marker depth-tested (hull hides it, still visible from orbit), hidden on ascent.

findings.issue: 'SITE 60 m' chevron pointer drawn at the bottom over the subtitle during lift-off.
Care center prefab extracted from the Black Market demo carried a weapon rack plus two axes scaled x5-6.7 above the roof: giant glowing cyan axes floating over the living district.
Blocked-zone rock (tall formation scaled uniformly to the zone width) towered ~40 m and filled half of the default colony camera.
findings.fix: Height capped at 1.3 x zone radius (width unchanged).

findings.issue: Big ground cover was pruned only by stem position, so canopies could grow through buildings.
findings.fix: Prune radius uses the instance's scaled canopy footprint (rects only for big plants).

findings.issue: Fuel pills overlapped ('24 fuel' under '8 fuel'); ARK tag unreadable on route lines.
findings.fix: Pills slide along their own route until free; ARK tag outlined.

findings.issue: Far-land speckle (one random shade per 10-90 m cell) read as a checkerboard at 300 m.
findings.fix: Speckle full at the map seam, fading to 20 % with distance.

findings.issue: Descent gauge set size on a full-rect-anchored Control every frame (240-1170 warnings per ascent capture).
The playable map still reads as a rougher, finer-faceted patch inside the smooth far land at 900 m (Ferrum, Sere).
findings.reason: Needs terrain LOD/blend between the playable heightmap and the far ring; not a small safe change.

findings.issue: The care center (where the first children are raised) is dressed as a black-market butcher stall: skulls, spines, ribs, tentacles, ham.
findings.reason: Art-direction call for the owner; prefab otherwise sound.

findings.issue: Opening star map/orbit panels leaves the bottom story subtitle peeking out under the panel frame.
findings.reason: Panels are created by ship_scene (owned by another agent this round).

findings.issue: Cockpit interior is washed salmon-pink by the nebula/sun ambient; low contrast vs. Sci-Fi Space key art.
findings.reason: Lighting tuning of the flight scene; left for a lighting pass.

findings.issue: Aurora band on Nivalis/Umbra has a straight, sharp lower edge across the whole view near the ground.
findings.reason: Shader/shape redesign (curtains instead of one cylinder); minor.

findings.issue: A build-bar tooltip can stay over the pause menu / zoomed-out colony in captures at 1280x720 (OS cursor parked over the bar before the warp).
findings.reason: Capture artifact, not seen in play.

findings.area: menu, settings, credits, load, ending, surface, flight
findings.issue: No defects found beyond the above at 1600x900, 1280x720 or UI scale 1.5 (star map panel fits via fit_layer).
